summary: FutureFuel Corp. filed an 8-K announcing it will release Q2 2026 financial results after market close on August 10, 2026, with a conference call on August 11. The filing is a routine earnings schedule announcement with no special-situation elements such as M&A, activism, or strategic changes. It merely discloses the timing of an earnings release and call details, with the press release furnished as Exhibit 99.1. This is an ordinary current report concerning scheduled financial reporting, not a transformative corporate event. What to watch: the upcoming earnings results for any unexpected operational or strategic disclosures.
